notes.title: Brutal Indie Unleashed
notes.content:
As you all know, Arms of God is a game built around brutally fighting your way through endless hordes of enemies. That’s why we couldn’t miss Brutal Indie Unleashed.
Along with taking part in the Steam event, we have a brand-new exclusive trailer where you can learn about why we decided to include gore in Arms of God in the first place, how we treat it as more than just a visual effect, and what we're trying to achieve with our hand-crafted dismemberment system. 

If you're curious about the design philosophy behind the brutality and why every cut matters in our game, check it out. 👀


If you’re curious and missed the live stream, check it out here:
[previewyoutube="8_4Ge2_ZmZ4;full"][/previewyoutube]
During the event, you’ll also be able to watch gameplay on our Steam page.

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3100310/Arms_of_God/?l=polish"][/dynamiclink]
And very soon, we’ll be setting off on a long journey to showcase the game to you but more on that in the next announcement. 🚀

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45217132/07e5c5e8bcded761ef2a8e0032622fb5366961e7.png"]

notes.title: New game mechanic revealed - The Crux
notes.content:
Introducing the Crux – A New Core Mechanic in Arms of God! ⚔️🔥

During the first playtests, many of you asked about the mysterious cross that the protagonist places on the battlefield at the start of each level. Today, we’re answering that question and unveiling a brand-new mechanic that you’ll be able to test in the upcoming open playtests!

What is the Crux?
The Crux is no ordinary artifact - it is a relic of divine power, forged through ancient rites by the last remnants of the Templar Order. It is both a weapon and a symbol, channeling the will of God into raw destructive force. In the hands of the protagonist, it serves as a beacon of holy retribution, but its full potential depends on the souls it consumes.

Each time the Crux is placed on the battlefield, it acts as an anchor for divine energy, gathering the remnants of fallen demons. These souls are drawn into the Crux, fueling its power and unlocking new effects as the battle progresses. Depending on your strategy, you can collect these souls yourself to enhance your weapon build, or you can let the Crux absorb them, making it stronger instead. Choosing between empowering yourself or the Crux will shape the flow of battle and your approach to combat.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45217132/7514687a630b755538ea0d6bfd3608f236d468bc.png

How Does the Crux Work?
The Crux does not remain static - it evolves based on the souls left behind by your slain enemies. The more souls it absorbs, the more potent its abilities become.

Your character levels up by collecting experience. Each new level unlocks unique Crux abilities, shaping its impact on the battlefield. These abilities fall into several categories:

🛡️ Defensive Enhancements: Blessings – Buffs that enhance the Templar when standing within the Crux’s sacred aura, strengthening your survivability or offensive potential.

🔥 Offensive Amplifications: Curses – Debilitating effects that weaken enemies within the Crux’s aura, making them more vulnerable to your attacks.

⚡ Strategic Support: Actions – The Crux can unleash devastating holy forces, including piercing beams, explosive energy waves, and divine smites that obliterate enemies. It can also stun foes, making them vulnerable to critical strikes, or provide supportive effects, such as healing, lifesteal, and projectile deflection.

🛜 Aura Enhancements - Upgrades that expand the Crux’s aura or reduce the cooldown of its abilities, allowing for more frequent and powerful activations.

✝️ Burden of Faith - The most unique upgrade - Unlocking the ability to move the Crux mid-battle, repositioning it to maximize its influence on the battlefield.

Crux Upgrade Tree – Strategic Progression
The Crux’s upgrades follow a tree-based progression system. Each time you select an upgrade, adjacent upgrades on the tree become available for future selection.

On level up, three upgrades are randomly chosen from your currently unlocked options. This means that the direction you take in the upgrade tree determines which future upgrades you’ll have access to. Careful planning is essential - will you focus on curses, blessings, powerful actions, or mobility?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45217132/65edc8153fc9844a624986d018d3addb789fd7ac.png

The upcoming open playtests will introduce this mechanic for the first time, allowing us to fine-tune its effects based on your feedback. We can’t wait to see how you’ll use the Crux to purge the infernal legions!

💬 Let us know what you think! Join the discussion on our Discord and don’t forget to wishlist Arms of God on Steam!

See you on the battlefield, Templars. ⚔️🔥

notes.title: Update – The Ruins, UI Work, and a New Gameplay Mechanic
notes.content:
We’re hard at work pushing Arms of God forward, and the progress has been super exciting. We’re working on several things simultaneously, and today we’d like to share the progress we’ve made over the past few weeks. A huge thank you to everyone who played the Alpha Demo and shared their feedback! We’ve carefully gone through it and will do our best to reflect your needs in the ongoing development.

Act One: The City Ruins and the Path to the Cathedral
The game will be divided into four acts, and today we’d like to show you a new concept art for the first one.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45217132/8d05ae5e6a7e98d9be75a30b101836ff3d14b7b1.jpg

The player's initial goal will be to make their way through the ruins of a city and reach the Cathedral, which will serve as the hub for meta-progression and the starting point for future challenges. Below, you’ll find an early screenshot from one of the levels.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45217132/792e70bd2a2a421c32d201bde1c87ea5f22d6c9f.png

UI Updates
From the beginning, we knew the UI in our game would be something we’d iterate on until launch, and this month was no different. We’ve improved the readability a bit and updated the visuals for the parchment and background elements.

Additionally, we’re working on expanding the Character Tab and its skill tree, but we’ll share more about that in the next update!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45217132/c6ecb9061bb79aea433e4d505c24a3c42cf8613b.gif

New Character
We’re also testing new abilities for upcoming heroes. The next character will have access to a Blink ability, which works similarly to the Dodge, but with greater movement range and more control. However, use it wisely, as it comes at the cost of a longer cooldown.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45217132/9f91f8757bae7aeb80d8f86396a49ac89d8ef287.gif

Camera Changes
One of the significant updates we made was adjusting the camera position. It’s now closer to a true isometric view, making it easier to control your surroundings from every angle.

New Gameplay Mechanic
We’re currently working on a new, key gameplay mechanic. For now, we don’t want to reveal too much, but the plan is for this mechanic to make its debut in the next closed beta tests (you’ll be able to sign up via our Discord here).

Thank you for your support and feedback! Stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: Alpha Demo Closed Playtests + Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello Warriors!

The first closed playtests for Arms of God are currently underway, and we’re so excited and curious to hear your first impressions and feedback! These playtests will run until November 30th, so if you want to join, simply sign up using this link:

https://mailchi.mp/22cb29818f04/arms-of-god-playtests

What are we testing?
During these playtests, you’ll be playing the alpha demo. It features the first level of the game—10 full waves, ending with a boss fight. Throughout the game, you’ll encounter 10 unique enemies, each with their own nefarious way of attacking you. You’ll also have access to the shop, where you can upgrade weapons and combine them with upgrades. Plus, there's an option to combine one weapon with another!

Patch Notes 
(since the PGA Expo version, October 25-27, 2024)

Game Localization

 Game localized into Polish and Chinese.

Extensive UI Updates:

 Icon colors now change based on their type.
 Updated highlighting for selections.
 Adjusted button positions.
 Improved item combination visuals, clearly showing what is being combined.
 Enhanced navigation for both gamepad and keyboard.
 Numerous minor visual tweaks and adjustments.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45217132/a650257df6f69731da44620c7741aa5521c46f2d.png
Character Enhancements:

 Improved character responsiveness: faster acceleration, quicker dodges, and increased dodge range.
 Enhanced boss animations with additional effects and scale adjustments – the boss is now much larger!
 Better visibility of enemy projectiles.

New Visual Effects and Menu Updates:

 Added animations to the main game menu.
 New character and weapon selection screen.
 Added gamepad/keyboard icons for actions – the game now automatically switches inputs based on the device in use.
 Updated weapon effects, introducing a new type of damage: Holy Damage!

New Weapon Categories:

 Grenade Launcher – Fires explosive projectiles that arc into the center of enemy hordes. 
 Mine Launcher – Deploys mines that home in on the nearest enemies and explode on contact. 
 Heavenly Wrath – A projectile that instantly falls from the sky. 
 Laser Weapon – Slices through all enemies in its path in a fraction of a second.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45217132/48c60477a843dd6fdcd98760085dc20aed914989.png

Additional Weapon Enhancements:

 Melee weapons now generate additional shockwaves when upgrading the number of projectiles.

New Features:

 Added a game tutorial.
 Rebalanced and adjusted specific upgrades.
 New weapon firing sound effects.
 Numerous small fixes and quality-of-life improvements to enhance gameplay.


After the first few days of testing, the demo has been updated with the following fixes:


 Localization issues fixed
 ESC button now correctly exits the shop
 "Try again" option has been disabled
 You can no longer continue the game after completing wave 10 or dying


Thank you for the initial feedback on our Discord!

What’s missing in the alpha demo but planned for EA?

📖Story mode with ~50 unique levels
📈 Metaprogression
🏁 Quest tab
🤺 Character tab where you can level up the active skill tree for your chosen hero
🇯🇵 Localization for additional languages (Japanese, French, German, Portuguese, Spanish)
🔥 and more!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45217132/9736c751c6d53040e0ec56be081e347ccead4dcd.png

What’s next?
The alpha demo is just a preview. The full, “proper” demo is planned for release in April 2025, and it will definitely be preceded by another round of playtests. Join our Discord so you don’t miss any important updates on the development of Arms of God!

Thanks again for your support and feedback!

Additionally, we’re hosting a contest for everyone who plays the Arms of God alpha demo at WePlay Expo 2024. We’ll be giving away 10 free keys for the game’s Early Access launch on Steam to the players who achieve the highest scores during the event.

How to win?
1. Play the alpha demo at WePlay Expo and take a screenshot of your final score.
2. Share your score in the contest thread on Bilibili here: https://www.bilibili.com/opus/998888524086247444
3. The top 10 highest scores will win a prize!

notes.title: Arms of God – Game Announcement
notes.content:
Prepare for Battle, Warriors!

We’re thrilled to finally announce ARMS OF GOD! After years of hard work, we’re ready to show you what we’ve been building – a fast-paced roguelite auto-shooter that will challenge your reflexes and test your strategy.

In ARMS OF GOD, you'll step into an epic battle as a last member of the ancient "Arms of God" order with the divine mission to defeat demonic hordes and restore order on Earth. Remember! This is not just another auto-shooter - here's a taste of what you can expect:

https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3100310/extras/AS_Steam_Slomo_B.gif?t=1727249348

Key Features:


Wield 5 Weapons at Once: Equip up to five weapons simultaneously and combine them for devastating results. Why settle for less when you can create powerful synergies that will obliterate your enemies?


 Satisfying Gore System: Every hit feels impactful with our dynamic gore system, adding a visceral layer of satisfaction to each enemy takedown.


 Customizable Upgrades: Build your arsenal with unique weapon upgrades and combine them to create devastating builds that adapt to your playstyle.


 Hand-Crafted 3D World: Immerse yourself in beautifully hand-crafted 3D environments filled with dangerous foes, from corrupted beasts to otherworldly creatures.


 Roguelite Elements: Each run is a bit different, with permadeath keeping the challenge fresh. Only the strongest will survive the trials ahead.


About Dark Jay Studio
ARMS OF GOD is being developed by Dark Jay Studio, a husband-and-wife duo passionate about creating immersive, dark-themed games. Our focus is on small, technically polished, immersive titles that deliver intense, well-paced gameplay. With a strong focus on atmosphere and storytelling, we aim to transport players into captivating worlds.
The developer behind ARMS OF GOD was the main Co-Creator and Art Director on The Beast Inside, and has also worked on The Medium, Book of Demons, and now on Spectre: Divide. With ARMS OF GOD, we are excited to bring our expertise to the auto-shooter genre, while adding our own twist to the formula.


What's Next?
We're working hard to bring ARMS OF GOD to life, and we want to bring you along for the journey! Stay tuned for more updates, including sneak peeks, gameplay footage, and announcements of upcoming betas. We can't wait to share more with you soon.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45217132/d5812643ac42c79ec22fe2daa3c928515f57a1ab.gif

Wishlist Now!
Don't miss out on any updates – be sure to add ARMS OF GOD to your Steam wishlist today. Your support helps us reach more players and continue developing the best experience possible!
Join the discussion in our community hub, and let us know your thoughts. We’re eager to hear your feedback and ideas!

Stay blessed, warriors, and prepare for the ultimate battle in ARMS OF GOD!
